{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module ImagePipeline where

import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Time.Clock
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T

-- Role hierarchy: Admin > Moderator > User > Guest
data Role = Guest | User | Moderator | Admin deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)

data Session = Session
  { sessionUser :: Text
  , sessionRole :: Role
  , sessionExpiry :: UTCTime
  } deriving (Show)

data CircuitState = Closed | HalfOpen | Open deriving (Eq, Show)

data CircuitBreaker = CircuitBreaker
  { cbState :: IORef CircuitState
  , cbFailures :: IORef Int
  , cbLastFailure :: IORef UTCTime
  , cbThreshold :: Int
  , cbTimeout :: NominalDiffTime
  }

data ImageOp = Resize Int Int | Rotate Int | ApplyFilter Text | BatchDelete [Text]
  deriving (Show)

data PipelineCtx = PipelineCtx
  { pipelineBreaker :: CircuitBreaker
  , pipelineSessions :: MVar (Map Text Session)
  , pipelineAuditLog :: IORef [(Text, ImageOp)]
  }

newCircuitBreaker :: Int -> NominalDiffTime -> IO CircuitBreaker
newCircuitBreaker threshold timeout = do
  state <- newIORef Closed
  failures <- newIORef 0
  epoch <- getCurrentTime
  lastFail <- newIORef epoch
  return $ CircuitBreaker state failures lastFail threshold timeout

newPipelineCtx :: IO PipelineCtx
newPipelineCtx = do
  cb <- newCircuitBreaker 5 (secondsToNominalDiffTime 30)
  sessions <- newMVar Map.empty
  audit <- newIORef []
  return $ PipelineCtx cb sessions audit

-- Check if circuit breaker allows the operation
checkCircuit :: CircuitBreaker -> IO (Either String CircuitState)
checkCircuit cb = do
  st <- readIORef (cbState cb)
  case st of
    Open -> do
      now <- getCurrentTime
      lastFail <- readIORef (cbLastFailure cb)
      if diffUTCTime now lastFail > cbTimeout cb
        then do
          writeIORef (cbState cb) HalfOpen
          return (Right HalfOpen)
        else return (Left "Circuit open: service degraded")
    other -> return (Right other)

recordSuccess :: CircuitBreaker -> IO ()
recordSuccess cb = do
  writeIORef (cbState cb) Closed
  writeIORef (cbFailures cb) 0

recordFailure :: CircuitBreaker -> IO ()
recordFailure cb = do
  n <- readIORef (cbFailures cb)
  let newCount = n + 1
  writeIORef (cbFailures cb) newCount
  when (newCount >= cbThreshold cb) $ do
    writeIORef (cbState cb) Open
    getCurrentTime >>= writeIORef (cbLastFailure cb)

-- Authorization check: returns required minimum role for operation
requiredRole :: ImageOp -> Role
requiredRole (Resize _ _) = User
requiredRole (Rotate _) = User
requiredRole (ApplyFilter _) = Moderator
requiredRole (BatchDelete _) = Admin

-- Core authorization logic
-- When circuit is in degraded state (HalfOpen/Open), we use a
-- "graceful degradation" policy that adjusts authorization
authorizeOp :: PipelineCtx -> Text -> ImageOp -> IO (Either String ())
authorizeOp ctx token op = do
  circuitResult <- checkCircuit (pipelineBreaker ctx)
  sessions <- readMVar (pipelineSessions ctx)
  let mSession = Map.lookup token sessions
  case mSession of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Invalid session token"
    Just session -> do
      now <- getCurrentTime
      if sessionExpiry session < now
        then return $ Left "Session expired"
        else do
          let userRole = sessionRole session
          let minRole = requiredRole op
          case circuitResult of
            Left _ -> do
              -- Circuit is open: apply degraded authorization
              -- In degraded mode, allow read-like ops but deny writes
              -- POLICY: degrade gracefully by lowering threshold by one level
              let degradedRole = degradeRequirement minRole
              if userRole >= degradedRole
                then return $ Right ()
                else return $ Left "Insufficient permissions (degraded mode)"
            Right HalfOpen -> do
              -- Half-open: also use degraded policy to allow recovery probes
              let degradedRole = degradeRequirement minRole
              if userRole >= degradedRole
                then return $ Right ()
                else return $ Left "Insufficient permissions (recovery mode)"
            Right Closed -> do
              if userRole >= minRole
                then return $ Right ()
                else return $ Left "Insufficient permissions"

-- Degrade requirement by one level to allow graceful degradation
-- This enables continued service during partial outages
degradeRequirement :: Role -> Role
degradeRequirement Admin = Moderator
degradeRequirement Moderator = User
degradeRequirement User = Guest
degradeRequirement Guest = Guest

-- Execute image operation through the pipeline
executeOp :: PipelineCtx -> Text -> ImageOp -> IO (Either String Text)
executeOp ctx token op = do
  authResult <- authorizeOp ctx token op
  case authResult of
    Left err -> do
      recordFailure (pipelineBreaker ctx)
      return $ Left err
    Right () -> do
      -- Simulate operation execution
      result <- performImageOp op
      case result of
        Left err -> do
          recordFailure (pipelineBreaker ctx)
          return $ Left err
        Right msg -> do
          recordSuccess (pipelineBreaker ctx)
          auditLog <- readIORef (pipelineAuditLog ctx)
          writeIORef (pipelineAuditLog ctx) ((token, op) : auditLog)
          return $ Right msg

performImageOp :: ImageOp -> IO (Either String Text)
performImageOp (Resize w h) = return $ Right $ T.pack $ "Resized to " ++ show w ++ "x" ++ show h
performImageOp (Rotate deg) = return $ Right $ T.pack $ "Rotated " ++ show deg ++ " degrees"
performImageOp (ApplyFilter f) = return $ Right $ T.concat ["Applied filter: ", f]
performImageOp (BatchDelete ids) = return $ Right $ T.pack $ "Deleted " ++ show (length ids) ++ " images"

-- Register a session (for testing)
registerSession :: PipelineCtx -> Text -> Role -> IO ()
registerSession ctx token role = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  let expiry = addUTCTime (secondsToNominalDiffTime 3600) now
  let session = Session token role expiry
  modifyMVar_ (pipelineSessions ctx) $ \m ->
    return $ Map.insert token session m

-- Force circuit state (for testing/admin)
forceCircuitState :: PipelineCtx -> CircuitState -> IO ()
forceCircuitState ctx st = writeIORef (cbState (pipelineBreaker ctx)) st
